verdict.rationale: Notte documents a secure, encrypted credential vault, and its vault docs state the LLM never sees the actual credentials during agent execution. A guide shows an agent logging in with stored credentials. For 2FA, Notte offers identities (emails and phone numbers) for sign-up and 2FA challenges. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of TOTP-seed storage and automatic TOTP code generation during login, detailed docs on how the agent handles 2FA in the vault flow, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
